home.headline: I make production backends faster, safer, and easier to change.
home.intro: 5+ years across fintech, healthcare, SaaS, and AI. Now building the scheduling backend at CheckProof AB, a SaaS platform used in 35+ countries.
home.description: Versatile Backend Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable and reliable systems across startup, fintech, healthcare, and AI environments. Proven ability to design, refactor, and modernize Ruby on Rails and GraphQL architectures, integrate complex APIs, and lead initiatives that improve performance, reliability, and developer productivity. Experienced in backend services, workflow systems, dependency management, and system optimization for production environments.

highlights.summary: Rebuilt in Go with goroutines and distributed workers for the core wallet service.

highlights.title: Rails reliability overhaul
highlights.summary: A Rails 7.0 → 7.2 upgrade and every high-severity security issue removed on a large monolith.

highlights.title: Hospital system for 10+ hospitals

principles.title: Pin down the old behavior before replacing it.
principles.proof: Captured CheckProof's legacy scheduler in characterization tests, then moved customers' live schedules to the new system with a rollback switch that worked at any point.

principles.title: Make code safe to change, then change it.
principles.proof: Raised test coverage on Luce's Rails monolith from 26% to 77% in six months, brought backend dependencies from 26% to 83% up to date, and upgraded Rails 7.0 → 7.2.

principles.title: Ship in weeks, not quarters.
principles.proof: Built the CIMB Octo Saver backend API at PrivyID in 14 days, and Hirio, a multi-tenant applicant tracking system, in one month.
